task.goal: Independently prove or refute fixed-d centered Petz qudit bound under a rectangular-defect MGF
task.question: Does the stated MGF imply the centered O((r/N)^2) Petz divergence for arbitrary unitary-irrep states and all r=o(N)?
task.scope: Exact theorem only; excluded prior candidate routes not read; no descendants

assumptions: Permutation-invariant density matrix with arbitrary unitary-irrep sector states
Uniform Eexp(tK/sqrtN)<=Aexp(Bt²+Ct) for everyt>=0, A>=1 B,C>=0
Ordinary established Schur-Weyl and highest-weight inputs
contract.interface: N>=max(4,ceil4L²), r<=N/4: chi²<=sum_{k=2}^r(Gamma r/N)^k, with L=logA+B+C, c0=Aexp(B+1+C+2L), Gamma=2d(d²−1)e³c0². Hence all r=oN have centered chi² and KL O((r/N)^2).
